lookback_note: Looks back over the ENTIRE known DONKI archive published at or before as_of (no fixed recent lookback window) for the single most recent notification of ANY type, classifies it as event/quiet by its messageType (SEP/GST vs. everything else — see this module's docstring), and applies that SAME flat verdict to every candidate window without checking whether that notification's own event timing overlaps that window (main-prompt.md §11).
